prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 24 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1283; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision during a lane change, reporting low back pain with muscle spasm and restricted range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported crash, and the presenting complaints align with a lumbar strain. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient reports no prior injury to the lumbar region, and no pre-existing condition affecting this area was identified in the history. Care consisted of 24 visits including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency reduced over time as symptoms and mobility improved. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated entries. At discharge the patient had improved function and reduced pain, with a plan for independent home exercise and follow-up as needed.
